_comment: Which user parameters are driven by the shop tool inventory, and how.
{m} is expanded over `sizes`; {fit} is the active ISO 273 clearance series.
`target` and `floor` are Fusion expressions over user parameters (result in mm).
Modes: Up = smallest tool >= target; Down = largest tool <= target but >= floor (falls back to Up);
Nearest = closer of the two (ties go Up); Off = write the target unsnapped (e.g. helical-bored counterbores on CNC); Keep = leave the parameter untouched.
Optional per-rule annotations: nominal + pitch -> '% thread' note for tap drills; head_od -> actual radial clearance note for counterbores.
